text: To thank us for helping out in Tenhoukaku over a week, Miki Nikaidou wanted to prepare us a dinner in person. When we saw her in an apron, Wanjirou grabbed me and ran out of Tenhoukaku. I could only hear someone screaming behind us...
Ichihime
Mahjong Soul Shrine
Ichihime finally returned to Mahjong Soul Shrine when it was dark. She looked full of energy.
player
When I cleaned up the dishes, I subtly tried to get more information from her.
Full of energy?//nWhenever Ichihime ate Miki Nikaidou's food, she would become very disheartened and felt sick. But today was the opposite. I felt confused.
Ichihime, did you have dinner at Nikaidou's place today?
Nyaa? Ichihime has not have any dinner yet.

But I saw she was "taken" by Miki Nikaidou. How could she have not eaten anything? That's definitely not Miki Nikaidou's style, given that nobody could ever refuse her food... Perhaps there were other reasons.
Let me make you something for dinner then.
I made a simple dinner for Ichihime using the ingredients available in the kitchen. She enjoyed it thoroughly.//nWhen I cleaned up the dishes, I casually asked her a question.
How do you find the taste?
No way!//nI saw her finish two large bowls of rice.
Master, Master, why are you cleaning the dishes already? Ichihime hasn't had any dinner yet...
With tears in her eyes, Ichihime grabbed my clothes and looked at me like an abandoned stray cat. Confused, I made her some food again.
She soon finished the food again, but I couldn't see any shape change in her tummy. Was her stomach linked to a blackhole?
Third time's a charm. Give her another meal, I dare her to forget again
She cannot eat anymore. Even a blackhole can be filled up
If Ichihime wasn't joking with me, then she had some serious problem. She seemed to have no memories about whether she had dinner or not.
Looking at Ichihime, I struggled a little bit before cooking her another dinner, only to see her throwing all the food into the "blackhole" again.
Now that should be enough, right? I cleaned up the dishes again and thought about it.
Ichihime, was the dinner enough for you?
You just had your third dinner!
I was worried that eating non-stop could harm Ichihime's body. There was no blackhole after all.
No, you can't keep eating! You have already had two meals!
Nyaa?! Impossible! Master must be lying, nyaa!
Look at all these uncleaned dishes. They are all here because of you.
Nyaa! But Ichihime doesn't remember having any dinner at all!
Still having tears in her eyes, Ichihime grabbed my clothes and complained about "not having" any dinner. She looked helpless... but she sure could eat a lot.
The look on her face was genuine. I didn't think she was lying, but I had never encountered such a problem. So I sent Wanjirou a message hoping that we could find a solution together.
A couple of minutes later, I saw a plump figure at the door, sweating and gasping.
Wanjirou
*Heavy breathing*... W-what happened to Ichihime?
That's not good... But thinking again, Ichihime was all good until she went to that woman's place. Could it be that she ate something poisonous?
Wanjirou's suggestion was exactly what I guessed. Given Miki Nikaidou's "superb" cooking skills, I wouldn't be surprised if Ichihime became poisoned.
While we were discussing, Ichihime took a long yawn and fell asleep on the table. She probably had too much food and all the blood went to her stomach.
The next day
Ichihime... looked fine. Completely normal. Did she recover or not?
She didn't mention the dinner, so hopefully she is fine now.
What's this...
Just drink it. I have already had three pots of tea and really can't drink anymore.
Master, don't you like Ichihime's tea?
Ichihime looked confused as I hadn't taken the cup she offered. I had no choice but to finish it again.
Wanjirou, this must stop. We need to make Ichihime realize what's going on.
Do you think I don't want to do that?
Ichihime, do you know that you are suffering from amnesia right now?
Nyaa? Amnesia? What's that?
Amnesia is memory loss... For example, you have just made me a tea, but when I finish it, you would forget and pour me another cup.
Really? But Ichihime doesn't recall anything at all, nyaa...
Because you lose your memories every now and then!
Okay... Ichihime somewhat understands it.

I finally got her to understand the seriousness of her problem and didn't have to drink tea again. I gave Wanjirou a thumbs up, only to get a disdainful look in return and hear Ichihime's voice again.
…………//nAre you a goldfish?!!//nBut one thing I know is, if I don't think of a solution quickly, I soon will be drowned in tea.
This is a medical issue and must be addressed immediately. Take Ichihime to a doctor.
The person responsible could also be the solution. Take Ichihime to Miki Nikaidou.
Ichihime always said she didn't have dinner, but I saw her eating multiple meals... She didn't seem to be lying either. Could there be something wrong with her?
No other problems are found at this stage. I say we let her sleep and check again tomorrow.
Wanjirou looked at the already drooling Ichihime, nodded to my suggestion.
I took the cup of tea from Ichihime. It was just the right temperature - neither too hot nor cold. When I finished the tea and handed back the cup, she raised her head and glanced at me.
Before I could speak, Ichihime handed me another cup of tea.
While I discussed possible solutions with Wanjirou, Ichihime had been pouring tea for me non-stop. Soon, she finished a pot of water. I immediately stopped her from boiling more water.
I grabbed Ichihime and prepared to head for the hospital.
Master, Ichihime hasn't made tea for you yet, nyaa—
That's okay. In fact, I'm not that into tea.
She would soon forget whatever I said anyway. I only wanted her to stop giving me tea. I felt like I could hear the tidal waves in my stomach as I walked.

When we arrived at the hospital, there was already a long queue all the way from the main hall to the hospital entrance. Weirdly, everyone seemed to be in good spirits, making me wonder if I had come to the wrong place.
Central Hospital
Excuse me, do you know what happened today? Why are there so many people at the hospital?
I patted the person in front of me, trying to understand the situation.
Stranger A
Are you also here to see a doctor? I don't really know what happened either.
Alright, thanks.
...//nThis sounds so familiar. Did they also eat Miki Nikaidou's food?
As I was thinking, Ichihime started to chat with the person standing next to us.
...//nNow we have two repeaters.//nJust when I was worried about how to separate them, someone patted me on the shoulder.
Stranger B
Her name is Sekai. She had become like this ever since a man in a black cloak gave her a strange candy. Fortunately I didn't eat it.
What kind of candy?
He took something from his pocket and put it in my hand. It was a candy in the shape of a rabbit's head with a familiar grin.
I immediately recalled the final scene of the cat monster incident.
I think I know who is behind all this mess. Can I borrow this candy?

I wanted to take it to the doctor, but looking at the length of the queue, we probably won't be able to see one until the end of the day. I think we can trust you for this one. The future of Sekai depends on you!
I took the candy and Ichihime to Kaguyahime's home. She was talking with a young man in a black cloak, while the man was holding some similar rabbit-head candies in his hand.
Here came the evidence.//nI rushed over and grabbed the young man, who was trying to run away the minute he saw us.
I knew it was you guys!
Kaguyahime
Uhehe, you came here really fast. You certainly deserve my attention.
Why did you do this?
How do you call this intermittent amnesia a gift?
...Whatever, give me the elixir.
There is no elixir, but the duration of this pois-I mean, gift, is not that long anyway. It will last one day at max.
You said poison, didn't you?! Hey!
What are you talking about!? You are the one swinging around!
I didn't have time to run after Kaguyahime because I had to catch Ichihime, who was still swinging.
Master, Ichihime feels so sick. My stomach is burning... Nyaa-ouch, Miki's cooking is so terrible...
Did that candy manage to delay the effect of yesterday's dinner until now?//nSo the bad memories weren't erased. They are just delayed!
Thank goodness Ichihime is fine. I will make that rabbit pay for this later.//nBut Ichihime really should stop eating food offered by strangers.
Nothing could be done before we learn more about Ichihime's conditions. I must find out what happened to Ichihime at Miki Nikaidou's place.
Wanjirou and I took Ichihime to Miki Nikaidou. He had been complaining all the way.
Look at the time, I'm sure that woman has already started preparing lunch. Aren't we just going to kill ourselves?
Ichihime seems to be getting worse. We can't just sit and wait anymore.
But why do I have to go with you?
If four of us can start a Mahjong game, maybe Nikaidou will forget to cook.
I think you are just trying to take revenge on me for making you drink the tea.
How can you think so mean of me? But yeah, that's exactly what I'm thinking.
Miki Nikaidou's Tenhoukaku is not far away from Mahjong Soul Shrine. Seeing her in an apron, I tried to not run away and pushed Ichihime forward.
Tenhoukaku
Nikaidou, please help Ichihime.
Miki Nikaidou
Oopsie, what happened? Ichihime looks alright, doesn't she?
Ever since she came back from your place, she kept repeating the same thing.
Meanwhile, Ichihime demonstrated her symptoms.
Oh? This is quite interesting.
Miki Nikaidou walked around Ichihime as if she had discovered something fun.
I don't think... we need to eat them in person.
Hmm? But how can you know where the problem is without eating?
You've got a point, but...
What if all of us end up like her?
Hmm... That's a good point. Well, guess I won't eat then. If something really happens, at least I can still remember the recipe and explain the situation to the doctor.
...How confident must she be to accept the connection between Ichihime's problem and her cooking without even questioning? Wanjirou and I exchanged looks. Guess we had no choice.
Miki Nikaidou had always been very enthusiastic about cooking. But enthusiasm alone wouldn't be enough for a lot of things.
As we ate, I saw Wanjirou's face turned darker. But I certainly wouldn't look any better.//nWhen I swallowed the last mouthful of food, I suddenly heard Ichihime's screaming.
Nyaa——————
I looked up. She seemed terrified.
Since when did the day start?! Ichihime had been eating from dinner all the way to lunch at Miki's place!!!
Ichihime, do you still remember what happened after last night's dinner?
Nyaa... Ichihime felt terrible. Someone gave Ichihime a candy and said I would feel better after eating it... When Ichihime finally realized what happened, it's already this time...
Nikaidou, have you ever given Ichihime any candies?
Nope. She finished the meal and really wanted to go back, so I let her go.
It must be someone else then. But who could it be?//nI really couldn't find any clue and had to give up. I must teach Ichihime to not eat food offered by strangers.
The incident was finally resolved, and my vision went dark as I lost consciousness.//nMiki Nikaidou's dishes were surely toxic... Hope Mahjong Soul Shrine and Ichihime would remember my sacrifice.
As she spoke, Ichihime handed me another cup of tea.//nI felt very lost and took it blankly, drank it blankly and returned the cup blankly.
Just give it up. It's not Sekai's fault.
What do you mean?
Kaguyahime's Home
Yawn——————
Master, here you are, nyaa! Let Ichihime get you some tea.
For some reason, Master suddenly brought Ichihime to the hospital! Do you know why?
Oh c'mon! This is clearly a gift from the goddess. How dare you question my decision?
Uhehe, getting rid of the bad memories is a blessing, isn't it? Take that poor kitty for example. I helped her to forget the horrible food she ate yesterday, you know?
Woah~~~~~~~~~ Master, why are you swinging back and forth? Oops? What's going on? Why am I seeing more Masters?!
Miki, good day, nyaa!
Good day, Ichihime!
Oh, yesterday... Hehe, speaking of that, you are quite lucky. I was just about to improve yesterday's cooking techniques and make the same dishes. Why don't you eat them yourselves?
See, they will heal themselves. A goddess never lies! Well, now that the dwarf is alright, I shall excuse myself. Bye-bye!

I was woken up by Wanjirou's multiple calls in the early morning. When I entered Ichihime's room, I saw Wanjirou and her sitting face to face. Ichihime was pouring some tea, while Wanjirou looked desperate.
What exactly did you give her yesterday? She's been like that for all night.
